title: Model catalogue dropdown with filters and preference order
description: Implement model picker UI: dropdown showing all models from GET /models/catalogue, filters (reachability, capacity, terms, provider, modality), current model highlighted, click to pin to session (POST /session with model+profile), preference order management (reorder, add, remove), auto-cycling indicator, model-switched event handling (show notification bar).
acceptance_criteria: Dropdown shows all models from GET /models/catalogue
Filters: reachability, capacity, terms, provider, modality all work
Current model is highlighted in dropdown
Click to pin: POST /session with model+profile, session switches model
Preference order: reorder (drag), add, remove all work
Auto-cycling: indicator shows when auto-cycling is active
model-switched event: notification bar appears with new model name
